project.name: structured-proxy
project.description: Universal, config-driven gRPC to REST transcoding proxy. One binary, different YAML configs, different products. Works with any gRPC service via proto descriptor files.

packages.name: structured-proxy
packages.summary: Universal gRPC to REST transcoding proxy

deb.repoSetup:
curl -fsSL https://repo.sw.foundation/keys/sw.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/sw.gpg
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/sw.gpg] https://repo.sw.foundation/deb $(lsb_release -cs) main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/sw.list
sudo apt-get update
